G.claim: General mechanism rather than one model/environment artifact.
G.required_signature: Second model family plus second interactive environment with frozen transfer/no-rescue rules and end-task robustness.

T1.claim: Specific causal active-plan identity signal under matched observable reset state.
T1.not_yet: Persistence, checkpoint, compactness, generality, end-task superiority.
T1.required_signature: Episode-specific A/B sources differ only in ACTIVE ORDER; reciprocal +d/-d transplant changes exact first-divergent branch preference; active exceeds archived-order, unrelated-plan and random same-norm controls under preregistered all-family inference.

T1R.required_signature: Import primary selected layer/alpha/donor directions without reserve retuning; same causal/specificity gates on untouched families.

T2.claim: Persistence of a causally active plan state after a single intervention.
T2.key_neighbor_separation: This directly separates PlanCarry persistence from NPM-style per-token/repeated activation steering and TransMem-style answer-generation memory correction.
T2.required_signature: Inject once at the interruption boundary, then advance through a frozen common plan-independent action/observation prefix in the same persistent session/KV state; no reinjection, no recomputed patch, no repeated steering; later divergent branch remains donor-consistent.

T3.claim: Endogenous compact checkpoint rather than a paired diagnostic contrast.
T3.required_signature: Extract from pre-interruption state without paired counterfactual source at deployment; demonstrate causal sufficiency/minimality and explicit storage/precision accounting.

forbidden_broad_claims: first latent memory for LLM agents
first activation steering for agent memory
first causal localization of planning representations
first evidence that plans do not persist without context

nearest_neighbors.claim_restriction: Do not claim first demonstration that plans fail to persist or first context-eviction stress test.
nearest_neighbors.name: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
nearest_neighbors.nonoverlap_for_plancarry: Does not establish a content-specific matched active-plan identity carrier, reciprocal A<->B causal transplant under identical observable reset state, or a single-injection persistent checkpoint.
nearest_neighbors.overlap: Directly establishes that plan information can decay from hidden state and that plan eviction harms agent performance; motivates persistence as a real problem.

nearest_neighbors.claim_restriction: Do not claim first causal localization or first activation patching of latent planning.
nearest_neighbors.name: Where's the Plan? Locating Latent Planning in Language Models with Lightweight Mechanistic Interventions
nearest_neighbors.nonoverlap_for_plancarry: Studies forward-looking rhyme constraints rather than interrupted agent plan identity/persistence; does not establish transport across reset or a reusable checkpoint.
nearest_neighbors.overlap: Uses probing and activation patching to localize causally used future-plan information in language models.

nearest_neighbors.claim_restriction: Do not claim first activation-space procedural memory, first training-free agent memory steering, first contrastive procedural steering vector, or first activation steering evaluated on ALFWorld.
nearest_neighbors.name: Neural Procedural Memory: Empowering LLM Agents with Implicit Activation Steering
nearest_neighbors.nonoverlap_for_plancarry: NPM is task/skill memory synthesized from historical successful/failed experience and repeatedly injected during generation. It does not, in the reviewed paper, isolate episode-specific active-plan identity under an identical observable world state via reciprocal A<->B matched transplant, nor test whether one injection survives a later common action/observation prefix without reinjection.
nearest_neighbors.overlap: Training-free procedural agent memory via contrastive hidden-state steering vectors; evaluated on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld and BabyAI. At inference it retrieves historical tasks, synthesizes a task-specific direction, and adds that direction to the residual stream during autoregressive generation.
nearest_neighbors.required_baseline_role_if_t1_survives: NPM is a conceptually close system baseline. Compare or clearly distinguish repeated task-skill steering from episode-specific causal plan checkpointing; T2 must explicitly prohibit reinjection to make persistence evidence nontrivial.

nearest_neighbors.claim_restriction: Do not claim first use of historical hidden states as reusable memory or first latent memory applied during generation.
nearest_neighbors.name: TransMem: Transforming Hidden States into Memory for Large Language Models
nearest_neighbors.nonoverlap_for_plancarry: Learned parametric memory module for long-context information utilization rather than matched active-plan identity causality; not an interruption-reset plan-carrier test and not a single endogenous episode checkpoint with reciprocal branch control.
nearest_neighbors.overlap: Uses sparse historical hidden states as memory and a learned transformation/gating module applied during answer generation; reports gains on LoCoMo, HotpotQA and MemoryAgentBench across Qwen and Llama backbones.

paper_positioning.core_sentence: The differentiator is not that activations can store or steer procedural behavior; it is whether an episode-specific active-plan identity can be causally isolated under a matched observable state, transported across reset, and—after one injection—remain behaviorally active through subsequent interaction without textual replay or repeated steering.
paper_positioning.minimum_high_tier_story: T1 + untouched T1R + T2, with NPM/TransMem/latent-planning/context-decay neighbors explicitly bounded. T3 materially strengthens the contribution from causal signal to checkpoint/memory object.
paper_positioning.weak_story_to_avoid: T1 alone framed as a new memory system or a new activation-steering method.
